description.value: Connor Lake Cabin is a BC Parks wilderness hut located in Height of the Rockies Provincial Park in the Kootenays, one of BC's largest and most remote wilderness parks. As a backcountry shelter, it offers touring cyclists a basic overnight refuge deep in the Rockies, well away from road services. The OSM position is noted as approximate, so route-planning should account for some uncertainty in its exact location.
